ranked.headline: Computational correction of batch, missingness and artifacts in single-cell omics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair batch correction, imputation, and artifact removal across single-cell proteomics, transcriptomics, and spatial data.

ranked.headline: Tissue-resolved models separate regulatory axes and causal effects across contexts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints resolve genomic effects by tissue, sex, and population using multi-tissue eQTL, haplotype decomposition, and single-cell CNA methods.

ranked.headline: Read-based tools for detecting microbes and strains directly from sequencing reads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published app benchmark or refine read-level classifiers for pathogens, strains and amplicon platforms.

ranked.headline: Automated force field parametrization and structure generation for biomolecular MD
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers add automated input generation for coarse-grained, cyclic peptide, and DNA simulations.

ranked.headline: Learned sequence embeddings increasingly drive biological prediction and annotation
ranked.summary: Pretrained protein language models are now transferred to mRNA, repeats, and operons, alongside new fold benchmarks and pretraining.

ranked.headline: Recovering unobserved cell dynamics from snapshots via transport and generative models
ranked.summary: Destructive and static single-cell and imaging data increasingly motivate generative and transport-based methods that reconstruct temporal dynamics.

ranked.headline: Inferring cell-state transitions from single-cell snapshots and paired measurements
ranked.summary: Snapshot single-cell and spatial data lack time resolution, so new methods infer trajectories, fates, and perturbation responses computationally.

ranked.headline: Learned models of biological context and evaluation rigor in molecular prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers test whether learned biomolecular models capture biological state and hold up under stricter evaluation.

ranked.headline: Assembly-derived structural variants enable imputation-based association testing
ranked.summary: Long-read assemblies and statistical tools now resolve structural variants and homologous regions that short reads handle poorly.

ranked.headline: Computing metabolic health readouts from lipidomic and transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Plasma lipidomics, adipose transcriptomics, and diabetic heart multi-omics are now being reduced to defined indices of metabolic health and dysregulation.

ranked.headline: Transformers and annotation tools infer genomic structure from contacts and sequence
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a Drosophila reference genome apply structure-aware inference and annotation to pangenome and chromatin-scale genomic data.

ranked.headline: Deep learning and pairwise models map TF binding and promoter TSS co-deployment
ranked.summary: Sequence-based models now predict TF affinity, promoter architecture, and enhancer-promoter contacts from DNA and chromatin data.

ranked.headline: Bayesian and simulation-based inference constrain parameters of biological models
ranked.summary: Simulation-trained and closed-loop Bayesian methods now estimate biological model parameters from costly or indirect measurements.

ranked.headline: Coupling model structure to prior knowledge across biomarkers, transcriptomics and aging
ranked.summary: Explicit prior encoding in biomedical models is being applied to reference intervals, aging clocks, gene regulation and patient subtyping.

ranked.headline: Machine learning models prioritise sequence variants for experimental follow-up
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers couple learned sequence models to choosing which variants, antibodies, and perturbations to test experimentally.

ranked.headline: Pretrained models for protein-ligand affinity, nucleic acid docking, pocket druggability
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend self-supervised and geometric pretraining to affinity, docking and pocket tasks using structure-based inputs.

ranked.headline: Learned models and simulations probe protein flexibility, disorder and binding
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple experimental data, learned models and simulation to assess flexibility, disorder and binding in proteins.

ranked.headline: Conformational ensembles coupled to quantitative binding validation for flexible targets
ranked.summary: Recent items pair MD-derived conformational ensembles with quantitative binding free energy benchmarks against drug leads and RNA-ligand complexes.

ranked.headline: Polymer and coarse-grained models explain chromatin and nuclear domain organization
ranked.summary: Recent polymer and coarse-grained simulations model chromatin and bacterial chromosome organization from explicit physical rules.

ranked.headline: Causal and analytical frameworks for designing and interpreting perturbation screens
ranked.summary: Preprints now give analytical power formulas and causal mediation tools for Perturb-seq, enabling design and inference without repeated simulation.

ranked.headline: Long-read and deep learning methods resolve transcript structure and splicing variation
ranked.summary: Recent tools refine nascent-mature transcript assembly, splicing prediction, and endogenous retrovirus quantification from RNA-seq data.

ranked.headline: Biomedical prediction models with built-in uncertainty or rule-level interpretability
ranked.summary: Clinical and chemical prediction tasks increasingly need calibrated reliability estimates or readable decision rules to support downstream use.

ranked.headline: Web platforms and network methods integrate omics with metabolic modeling
ranked.summary: Interactive portals and benchmarked reconstruction tools make multi-omics and metabolic modeling more accessible for integrative analysis.

ranked.headline: Haplotype selection and lineage-aware annotation scale comparative genome analysis
ranked.summary: Thousands of animal genomes and pangenome collections now enable comparative analyses that expose method-dependent biases in evolutionary inference.

ranked.headline: Histology-coupled learning resolves spatial transcriptomics from spots to single cells
ranked.summary: Multimodal models now assign expression to subcellular and single-cell scales, moving beyond spot-level spatial transcriptomics.

ranked.headline: Membrane context and mechanics shape viral and enzyme molecular behavior in simulation
ranked.summary: Simulations now pair explicit membrane composition and phase behavior with molecular-scale descriptors across peptides, viral proteins, and enzymes.

ranked.headline: Learned models now score variant pathogenicity and prioritize clinical variant review
ranked.summary: Foundation and language models are being applied to variant-level interpretation alongside read-level methylation modeling in liquid biopsy.

ranked.headline: Learned models infer peptide identity and modifications directly from mass spectra
ranked.summary: Transformer and flow-based models now sequence peptides de novo, including zero-shot discovery of open modifications from raw spectra.

ranked.headline: Bayesian models infer latent infection states from PCR and titration assay data
ranked.summary: Latent-state models now recover infectiousness and transmission from indirect data, including PCR-only viral kinetics and raw titrations.

ranked.headline: Leakage-aware benchmarking of molecular prediction and design tools across tasks
ranked.summary: Blinded and external benchmarks now expose data leakage and inconsistent evaluation across antimicrobial, binding, screening, and backbone design tools.

ranked.headline: Structural priors in biological graph models: layer design, explanation, edge statistics
ranked.summary: Biological graph models are moving beyond generic embeddings toward explicit encoding of gene-set, patient-similarity, and interaction priors.

ranked.headline: Standardized metrics and uncertainty estimates for omics inference tool reliability
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair omics inference methods with explicit uncertainty models, benchmark metrics, or replicate-aware scoring to test their outputs.

ranked.headline: Models target protein conformational diversity and faster structure generation
ranked.summary: Five May 2026 preprints pair faster generative structure prediction with methods for diverse conformational sampling.

ranked.headline: Chirality-aware molecular encodings for drug affinity and side-effect prediction
ranked.summary: Stereochemistry-aware drug encodings are now paired with protein and language embeddings for affinity and side-effect prediction.

ranked.headline: Open software tools automate proteomics, protein annotation, and structure file analysis
ranked.summary: Current releases package quantitative proteomics, protein annotation, and structure parsing as scriptable, reproducible pipelines.

ranked.headline: Phylogenetic trees quantify neutral rates and fitness effects in influenza proteins
ranked.summary: Large influenza sequence collections and a 13-genome P. falciparum pangenome now support phylogeny-based estimates of mutation effects and variation.

ranked.headline: Pangenome graphs and cross-species atlases resolve structural variants and stress loci
ranked.summary: Graph-based pangenomes now resolve structural variation and drought, stress, and trait loci that linear references miss.

ranked.headline: Learned and biophysical models infer spiking neuron timing, activity, and conductance structure
ranked.summary: Deep learning and spiking-network models now recover neuron timing, activity classes, and conductance parameters from spike data.

ranked.headline: Continuous phenotypic heterogeneity steers treatment relapse and host-virus coevolution
ranked.summary: Adaptive therapy and virus-defective particle studies now model continuous phenotypes, where high plasticity accelerates tumor relapse.

ranked.headline: Calibrated computational models test biological hypotheses against data structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published genotype-phenotype model paper refine parameter fitting and null-model baselines for biological simulations.
